summary: A universal conditional L-infinity bound for the selected three spectral coordinates given the complementary spectral coordinates is false. For iid Uniform[0,1] X1..X4, U=(X1+X2)/sqrt(2), V=(X1-X2)/sqrt(2), the conditional density of (U,X3,X4) given V=v has sup 1/(sqrt(2)-2|v|), which diverges as |v| approaches 1/sqrt(2). This is an exact rank-three spectral geometry with eigenvalues (1,1,1,0). It refutes only the conditional-projection-cap completion proposed as an open gap in owner revision 2026-09-22.8; it does not refute rank-three coarea or the full QFORM conjecture.
